title: What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models
summary: vLLM Semantic Router released Decision 3.0, 5 Apache-2.0 multimodal decision models from 0.8B to 27B. They answer choice, yes/no and score questions about text and images in one call, without generating text.
